scenario_title: Memory leak in the program loader
title: Elevated 5xx errors on node-svc
impact: A share of requests failed with 5xx on node-svc
symptom: [ANOMALY] node-svc 2026-08-28 03:21-03:50: node-svc: 143 of 157 log lines were non-INFO between 2026-08-28 03:21 and 2026-08-28 03:50 UTC (peak error ratio 0.91 vs baseline median 0.0). 31 error templates, 30 first seen in this span. 30 lines carry an alert label.

_templates.macro: Deploy {version_to} of node-svc leaks one program-image buffer per failed load; the smaller instance type from the earlier launch-template change ran out of memory first.
_templates.micro: {file}:{line} ({symbol}) drops free(image_buf) on the error path.
_templates.remediation: Roll back node-svc {version_to} -> {version_from}; restore free(image_buf) at {file}:{line}; add a leak check (valgrind) to the ppd suite.

rca.macro: Deploy v5.21.0 of node-svc leaks one program-image buffer per failed load; the smaller instance type from the earlier launch-template change ran out of memory first.
rca.micro: node/ciod/ciod_loader.c:233 (ciod_load_program) drops free(image_buf) on the error path.
rca.remediation: Roll back node-svc v5.21.0 -> v5.20.0; restore free(image_buf) at node/ciod/ciod_loader.c:233; add a leak check (valgrind) to the ppd suite.

action_items: Add a regression test covering ciod_load_program (node/ciod/ciod_loader.c).
Alert on the error signature `data storage interrupt`.
